strings.en: Careless fool!
Have at you!
You're within my range!
First strike's mine!
I challenge you!
I will fulfill my mission!
A battle against the strong is just what I want!
On the pride of the Fury, and on my own honor!
I dedicate my strength to the Fury!
I'll fight in a way worthy of a Junior Knight of the Fury!
However great your renown may be!
My life, for the glory of the Fury!
Lord Al-Van, prepare yourself!
Lord Al-Van.../　To think I'd cross swords with you as an enemy...!
This fight isn't over yet!
I'll turn this around from here!
I won't just sit here and take it!
I'll take back the Throne Unit for sure!
The Throne Unit doesn't belong to you!
To turn the Blade of the Imperial Family against us...!
First I have to stop the Throne Unit's movements...!
To think even Basileus would side with them...!
I'll destroy the Bellzelute!
I'll dispose of that experimental unit here!
No matter how they upgrade that experimental unit!
No matter how much it's modified,/　it's still a counterfeit!
That thing can't possibly be the key!
That giant body makes a fine target.
The amount of weaponry doesn't decide a fight!
I won't let a counterfeit act so high and mighty!
I'll strike down the Vaula!
If I sink their mothership, even they...!
Here I come, Grungust!
A Grungust type, a worthy opponent!
I'll snap that great sword in two!
A Hückebein dead copy is nothing!
Your fists won't work on me!
It's only a gun platform!
The latest Hückebein type...!
I'll strike before they combine!
SRX, a worthy opponent!
That machine's breakthrough power/　is not to be underestimated...!
As a Junior Knight, I challenge the White Knight!
A fake Alteisen is nothing!
That speed means nothing/　once I see through its maneuvers!
No matter how it's modified, it's still an old model!
A Gespenst is nothing to fear!
Dygenguar! Your head is mine!
I won't let you swing that great sword!
The Double G will bring me unmatched glory!
That thing is no divine dragon!
I'll test the power of a Masoukishin!
So that's the Granzon...!
Neo Granzon... I must proceed with caution!
The machine that broke Larseilam.../　It must be eliminated!
I'll overcome the difference in size with skill!
Thick armor won't help when you move like that!
I won't be fooled by your massive frame!
That new model moves well for a large unit, but...!
New model, if you can't turn sharply...!
No matter how it's been upgraded,/　if its characteristics haven't changed...!
Adding more wings won't help you!
I won't fall behind a Jevilun!
Even if the Jevilun grows huge!
Take this back!
You won't escape!
I'm coming at you too!
I won't let you withdraw!
I've regained my footing! Here I come!
I-I've failed!!
Is this... the end...!!
M-My life... I don't regret...!!
Gwaaah!
Even if I fall, the Fury will...!!
My life, for the imperial family!!
Gwaaah!!
My life, for the Fury...!!
Th-The darkness of Voda...!!
I-I can't retreat here!
What?! It read my movements perfectly?!
As long as my unit moves, I can fight!
I-I can't run out of strength yet!
Gah! For the Volrent to be beaten this badly!
I-I have my pride as a Junior Knight!
Grr! As I thought, they're strong!
Ngh... A battle worth staking my life on...!
Ngh! The Extractor's output!
I-I'll do what must be done/　with the strength I have left!
Th-This is a trial to become a knight.../　I'll overcome it no matter what!
My life is already dedicated to the imperial family!
Even if it costs me my life, Lord Al-Van...!
To retreat without retaking the Throne Unit...!
For an Earthling to handle the Granteed like that...!!
Ngh, ugh... Am I no match for the Throne Unit...?!
Why does our guardian deity/　lend its power to Earthlings?!
Damn you, you mere experimental unit!
A-As if I'd let a counterfeit shoot me down!
Th-The Bellzelute has this much firepower...!
I-Is this the power that/　held back the Vaula...?!
Being pushed back by that many weapons...!
D-Damn you, Grungust!
Even a dead copy performs this well...!
The latest Hückebein, tough as I thought!
W-What?! How fast it closed in!
Damn you, Einst! You'll pay for that!!
That high mobility.../　How can the pilot withstand the G-forces...?!
To be toyed with by a Gespenst type...!
I can't see through the Cybuster's movements?!
Too much power for Earthlings.../　It must be defeated here!
I'm at a disadvantage in a contest of power...!
Ngh, ugh... What power!
Did I misjudge the new model's performance...?!!
I-Is the Jevilun's power growing?!
Grr! Not bad!
I won't let this stand!
Ngh, this is no ordinary opponent!
Ugh! I slipped up!
Hmph, a tough opponent...!
As I thought, that lot will be an obstacle!
Ngh! More power than the data showed...!
That's what makes this fight worthwhile!
A Junior Knight doesn't retreat/　over something like this!
My read backfired?!
Not yet! This fight isn't over!
Grr! What kind of example is this for the Squires?!
I won't let myself be overwhelmed like this!
Ngh! Am I no match for a knight?!
Even with a different pilot,/　the Throne Unit's power is...!
To experience the Throne Unit's power firsthand!
Ngh! So this is the Throne Unit's true power...!
An Earthling drew out even more/　of the Throne Unit's power?!
That experimental unit just won't give up...!
Damn you, Bellzelute! You'll pay for that!
It may have been refitted, but for an/　experimental unit to have this much power...!
Tch! That's no ordinary armor!
Th-That much movement at that size...!
Just what is that counterfeit's output...?!
Damn you, Vaula! You'll pay for that!
I've blocked it, Grungust!
Not by a fake Hückebein!
Grr! I can't let it get to the front!
Isn't it just an inferior version of the Alteisen...?!
To fall behind an old model...!
That fighting spirit, that sword... It's no ordinary foe!
I won't let you go any further, Double G!
Ngh! Impressive, Cybuster!
Blast it! I can't stop the Granzon!
Its power is overwhelming me?!
It moves well for such a giant!
I have to deflect the large unit's attacks well...!
Ngh! I need data on that new model...!
That thing is faster than before!
Damn that Jevilun, not bad!
It wounded me...!
I won't flinch at this!
It just hit me, that's all.
No need to even check the damage...!
Did I overestimate them?
What, is that meant to be a feint?
Hmph, weak.
Not as good as I thought.
I didn't mean to let my guard down...!
And you mean to fight us, the Fury, with that...!
Tch, I'll dodge the next one!
That's nothing!
In a duel with a knight,/　retreating means certain defeat...!
Looks like you haven't mastered the Granteed.
Even a Throne Unit depends on its pilot, it seems.
My opponent is the Granteed Dracodeus.../　I can't let my guard down for an instant!
Damn that Bellzelute, what cheeky tricks!
I won't let the counterfeit do as it pleases!
All they upgraded was its agility?!
What did they even upgrade, Bellzelute?
I can't waste time on a counterfeit!
Looks like it doesn't have/　the firepower its looks suggest!
Too naive, Vaula!
Damn that Grungust, is that all you've got?!
What's wrong? Is that cannon just decoration?
So this is all it can do without combining...
Is the SRX just testing the waters...?!
The name White Knight doesn't suit you!
As I thought, this is all a Gespenst can do.
Brandish that great sword all you like, we won't flinch!
It's feeble for something that looks like that.
So it makes up for its sluggishness with power!
Nothing worth noting besides its power...!
It seems neither the machine nor the pilot is ready.
Hmph, all it did was add wings.
A Jevilun is no enemy of mine!
I've seen through it!
Come as many times as you like, it won't matter!
You won't hit me!
Too naive!
As if you could catch the Volrent!
If I read its first move...!
Where are you aiming?!
So it came after me...!
That trick won't work on me!
That won't work on me!
Charging in blindly won't help you!
So what?!
I've taken countermeasures.
A waste of effort!
I can't counterattack?!
They've shut down my moves...!
To have no choice but to endure...!
What humiliation...!
I have to get some distance for now...!
That was careless...!
Ngh, I can't keep up with it...!
Tch, I lost it!
Where did that thing disappear to?!
It got out of my range?!
Ngh, it knows how to fight...!
I can't do anything?!
It's not over yet!
I won't let up!
I won't let that opening slip by!
I'll follow Lord Al-Van!
Lady Fu-Ruu, leave the rest to me!
I'll support you, Lord Jua-Mu!
Chief Agent, sir, I'll support you!
Knight Commander, sir, we're with you!
I won't let you!
I can take this one!
I'll make it in time!
I'll be the shield!
Please fall back, Lord Al-Van!
Lady Fu-Ruu, fall back while you can!
Lord Jua-Mu, leave this to me!
Please fall back, Chief Agent, sir!
I'll be the Knight Commander's shield!
One more strike!
I won't let that opening escape me!
You let your guard down!
There!
Take this!
I'll hit you!
One target!
Take this!
Haaah!
I'll run you through!
Hyaah!
I'll run you through!!
Take this!
One more!!
Distance won't save you!
Nowhere left to run!
Take this too!
Go down with this!
This ends it!
Where are you looking?!
Maximum output!
Take thiiis!!
Move however you like, it's too late!
I've got you in my sights!
Fall into the darkness of Voda!!
